taxi_day.basis: PlaNexTrip (Near Rudransh Hospital, Patel Nagar, Bhopal) Pachmarhi gypsy charges page, rates labelled '2025 (Updated)': full-day combo of three routes (excl. Chauragarh trek) Rs 5,500-6,000 (midpoint 5,750); waterfall route 2,500-3,000; temple route 2,200-2,500; sunset route 1,800-2,200; midpoints used. Per gypsy for up to 6 tourists; forest entry/guide fees (Rs 300-700) are extra. Page says charges are fixed by the Forest Department/gypsy union; the official union list itself was not found.
taxi_day.notes: Gypsies are mandatory for the restricted forest circuits, so the route/full-day gypsy fare is the 'local day'. Tripadvisor forum posters report Rs 2,000-3,450 for a day plus forest fees (page itself 403 to fetch, not used). Single source.
